description: This file defines a client-side API layer for the Notes frontend application, providing functions to perform authenticated HTTP requests, retrieve the base API URL from environment variables, and manage access tokens via localStorage.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the backend API base URL from environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE or a fallback URL.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers = {}, auth = true } = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch call to the backend with specified parameters, handling JSON serialization, authorization headers, and response parsing.

methods.name: setAccessToken(token)
methods.description: Stores or removes a JWT token in localStorage for authorization purposes.

ctags.name: apiRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers = {}, auth = true } = {})/
